notes: Unlocking a level now unlocks everything below it, so buying A2 opens A1 too and the top level is simply the whole course. A course is a ladder and owning a rung without the ones under it made no sense: your daily reviews are full of the earlier level's words either way. Two ways the paywall leaked are closed. Taking the free placement test and landing deep no longer unlocks the quizzes and mock exams of every level it skipped, and it no longer drops six hundred words of a paid course into your reviews; both now wait until you own the level. Prices are per language: through A1, through A2, or the whole course to B1.
